```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

read_csv_safe <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(NULL)
  csv_df <- utils::read.csv(
    path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE
  )
  if (nrow(csv_df) == 0) NULL else csv_df
}

dt <- function(df) {
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(htmltools::tags$p(htmltools::em("No data.")))
  }
  DT::datatable(
    df,
    rownames = FALSE,
    filter = "top",
    options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE)
  )
}

global_stats <- read_csv_safe(file.path("csv", "global_stats.csv"))
species_stats <- read_csv_safe(file.path("csv", "species_stats.csv"))
deteriorated_usm <- read_csv_safe(file.path("csv", "Deteriorated_USM.csv"))
rrmse_comparison <- read_csv_safe(
  file.path("csv", "species_rrmse_comparison.csv")
)

species_list <- if (!is.null(species_stats) && "species" %in% names(species_stats)) { # nolint: line_length_linter
  sort(unique(species_stats$species))
} else {
  character(0)
}

# Species with at least one Critical variable (matches RRmseComparison's
# critical_vars: status == "Critical" *and* n_obs > 10 - a variable can show
# Critical in the comparison plot without meeting that n_obs bar, see the
# callout note on the species page).
has_status <- !is.null(rrmse_comparison) &&
  all(c("species", "status", "n_obs") %in% names(rrmse_comparison))
species_with_critical_vars <- if (has_status) {
  critical <- rrmse_comparison[
    rrmse_comparison$status == "Critical" & rrmse_comparison$n_obs > 10, ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  unique(critical$species)
} else {
  character(0)
}
```

## Species

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

if (length(species_list) == 0) {
  cat("\n\nNo species-level data available.\n\n")
} else {
  cat(paste(
    "\n\n<style>",
    ".species-list { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; max-width: 32em; }", # nolint: line_length_linter
    ".species-list li {",
    "  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;",
    "  padding: 0.6em 1em; margin-bottom: 0.4em;",
    "  border: 1px solid #e2e2e2; border-radius: 6px;",
    "  transition: background-color 0.15s ease;",
    "}",
    ".species-list li:hover { background-color: #f7f7f7; }",
    ".species-list a {",
    "  text-decoration: none; font-weight: 600; color: #2c3e50;",
    "}",
    ".species-list a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }",
    ".species-badge {",
    "  font-size: 0.8em; color: #c0392b; background: #fdecea;",
    "  border-radius: 999px; padding: 0.2em 0.7em;",
    "}",
    "</style>\n\n",
    sep = "\n"
  ))

  cat('<ul class="species-list">\n')
  for (sp in species_list) {
    badge <- if (sp %in% species_with_critical_vars) {
      ' <span class="species-badge">critical variables</span>'
    } else {
      ""
    }
    cat(sprintf(
      '<li><a href="%s">%s</a>%s</li>\n',
      file.path("plots", sp, "species.html"), sp, badge
    ))
  }
  cat("</ul>\n\n")
}
```
